ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (cream/white/tan) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant cream-colored background with widespread brownish-tan amorphous mottling across both lobes. A high-contrast black pigmented region is localized around the median notch and extends downward through the peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55-65 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels. Extremities (tips) show high-density, jagged topographical clusters with significant vertical variance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly symmetrical convex curves extending from the notch to the lateral tips, tapering into sharp, upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular ring-like scars visible; specifically, a cluster of three on the mid-left lobe and one distinct ring near the central black pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal dark linear marks are detectable on the left lobe, cutting through the tan mottling.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacle colonization (high-contrast, textured grey/white nodes) are concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread brownish/golden organic-looking discoloration across the majority of the light-pigmented surface area.
